blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY — College student volunteers from the Higaonon ethnic group in the city brought school supplies, books, clothes, and basic health services to children in remote Sitio Limunsudan, Barangay Rogongon, on Oct. 24, in celebration of Indigenous Peoples’ (IP) Month. The outreach activity gathered young people from different communities, including Muslims and Christians, in an initiative aimed at giving back to the community and supporting the education of IP children. The volunteers distributed school supplies and books donated by the Iligan City Public Library. Nursing students also offered free blood pressure checks to residents.
